'''Excommunicated''' is a [[debuff]] that causes affected targets to be unable to deal [[chaos damage]].

==Mechanics==
This only affects damage coming from the afflicted target. It does not prevent chaos damage coming from a [[damage taken as]] modifier even if they took damage from an Excommunicated enemy. {{il|Runegraft of Rotblood}} functions correctly as it grants conversion to the enemy, and is not a damage taken as effect.
